lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我們三個人，點六個菜夠不夠？這家店的菜我每樣都想吃吃看。
lines.simplified: 我们三个人，点六个菜够不够？这家店的菜我每样都想吃吃看。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen sān ge rén, diǎn liù ge cài gòu bú gòu? Zhè jiā diàn de cài wǒ měi yàng dōu xiǎng chī chi kàn.
lines.english: There are three of us. Are six dishes enough? I want to try everything here.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 太多了吧！上次我們也點了六個，最後剩下一半。
lines.simplified: 太多了吧！上次我们也点了六个，最后剩下一半。
lines.pinyin: Tài duō le ba! Shàng cì wǒmen yě diǎn le liù ge, zuìhòu shèngxià yíbàn.
lines.english: That's too many! Last time we ordered six too, and half was left over.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 吃不完可以打包啊。
lines.simplified: 吃不完可以打包啊。
lines.pinyin: Chī bù wán kěyǐ dǎbāo a.
lines.english: We can take what we don't finish home.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 上次打包回去，放在冰箱裡一個星期，最後還是丟了。要不然先點四個，不夠再加。
lines.simplified: 上次打包回去，放在冰箱里一个星期，最后还是丢了。要不然先点四个，不够再加。
lines.pinyin: Shàng cì dǎbāo huíqù, fàng zài bīngxiāng lǐ yí ge xīngqí, zuìhòu háishì diū le. Yàobùrán xiān diǎn sì ge, bú gòu zài jiā.
lines.english: Last time we took it home, it sat in the fridge for a week and got thrown out anyway. How about four first, and we add more if it's not enough?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好吧。不過這家的魚很有名，四個菜裡至少要有一個是魚。
lines.simplified: 好吧。不过这家的鱼很有名，四个菜里至少要有一个是鱼。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba. Búguò zhè jiā de yú hěn yǒumíng, sì ge cài lǐ zhìshǎo yào yǒu yí ge shì yú.
lines.english: All right. But their fish is famous, so at least one of the four has to be fish.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 沒問題，你們先看菜單，我去拿碗。
lines.simplified: 没问题，你们先看菜单，我去拿碗。
lines.pinyin: Méi wèntí, nǐmen xiān kàn càidān, wǒ qù ná wǎn.
lines.english: No problem. You two look at the menu, and I'll get the bowls.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們最後決定怎麼點菜？
prompt.simplified: 他们最后决定怎么点菜？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen zuìhòu juédìng zěnme diǎn cài?
prompt.english: How do they finally decide to order?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先點四個菜，裡面要有魚
choices.simplified: 先点四个菜，里面要有鱼
choices.pinyin: Xiān diǎn sì ge cài, lǐmiàn yào yǒu yú.
choices.english: Four dishes to start, one of them fish.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先點四個菜，吃不完再打包
choices.simplified: 先点四个菜，吃不完再打包
choices.pinyin: Xiān diǎn sì ge cài, chī bù wán zài dǎbāo.
choices.english: Four dishes to start, taking home what's left.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先點六個菜，裡面要有魚
choices.simplified: 先点六个菜，里面要有鱼
choices.pinyin: Xiān diǎn liù ge cài, lǐmiàn yào yǒu yú.
choices.english: Six dishes to start, one of them fish.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 只點四個菜，不夠也不再加
choices.simplified: 只点四个菜，不够也不再加
choices.pinyin: Zhǐ diǎn sì ge cài, bú gòu yě bú zài jiā.
choices.english: Only four dishes, no more even if it is not enough.

questions.why: He offers 先點四個，不夠再加 and her 好吧 accepts it with one condition: 至少要有一個是魚, a minimum inside those four. Taking leftovers home is her old idea, which he turned down after last time; six was her first number, which he called too many; and 不夠再加 makes four a start, not a limit.

focus.zh: 至少（最低條件）；最後的決定
focus.en: at least (a minimum condition); the final plan

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你下午就要回宿舍了，媽媽煮了幾樣菜，你帶回去吃。
lines.simplified: 你下午就要回宿舍了，妈妈煮了几样菜，你带回去吃。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ xiàwǔ jiù yào huí sùshè le, māma zhǔ le jǐ yàng cài, nǐ dài huíqù chī.
lines.english: You're going back to the dorm this afternoon. I've cooked a few dishes; take them with you.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 媽，宿舍的冰箱很小，大家的東西都放在裡面，我放不下啦。
lines.simplified: 妈，宿舍的冰箱很小，大家的东西都放在里面，我放不下啦。
lines.pinyin: Mā, sùshè de bīngxiāng hěn xiǎo, dàjiā de dōngxi dōu fàng zài lǐmiàn, wǒ fàng bú xià la.
lines.english: Mom, the dorm fridge is tiny and everyone's stuff is in it. There's no room.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那這袋玉米呢？是你外婆自己種的，不用放冰箱。
lines.simplified: 那这袋玉米呢？是你外婆自己种的，不用放冰箱。
lines.pinyin: Nà zhè dài yùmǐ ne? Shì nǐ wàipó zìjǐ zhòng de, bú yòng fàng bīngxiāng.
lines.english: What about this bag of corn, then? Your grandma grew it herself, and it doesn't need the fridge.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 玉米那麼重，我還要坐兩個小時的車。
lines.simplified: 玉米那么重，我还要坐两个小时的车。
lines.pinyin: Yùmǐ nàme zhòng, wǒ hái yào zuò liǎng ge xiǎoshí de chē.
lines.english: Corn is so heavy, and I have a two-hour ride.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 菜不帶就算了，玉米至少帶一半吧，外婆一直問你喜不喜歡吃。
lines.simplified: 菜不带就算了，玉米至少带一半吧，外婆一直问你喜不喜欢吃。
lines.pinyin: Cài bú dài jiù suàn le, yùmǐ zhìshǎo dài yíbàn ba, wàipó yìzhí wèn nǐ xǐ bù xǐhuān chī.
lines.english: Forget the dishes, then, but take at least half the corn. Grandma keeps asking whether you like it.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好啦，那我拿一半，剩下的下次再拿。
lines.simplified: 好啦，那我拿一半，剩下的下次再拿。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo la, nà wǒ ná yíbàn, shèngxià de xià cì zài ná.
lines.english: OK, OK, I'll take half, and the rest next time.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 兒子最後會帶什麼回宿舍？
prompt.simplified: 儿子最后会带什么回宿舍？
prompt.pinyin: Érzi zuìhòu huì dài shénme huí sùshè?
prompt.english: What will the son take back to the dorm?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 整袋玉米，不帶菜
choices.simplified: 整袋玉米，不带菜
choices.pinyin: Zhěng dài yùmǐ, bú dài cài.
choices.english: The whole bag of corn, and none of the dishes.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 一半的玉米，不帶菜
choices.simplified: 一半的玉米，不带菜
choices.pinyin: Yíbàn de yùmǐ, bú dài cài.
choices.english: Half the corn, and none of the dishes.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 媽媽煮的菜，不帶玉米
choices.simplified: 妈妈煮的菜，不带玉米
choices.pinyin: Māma zhǔ de cài, bú dài yùmǐ.
choices.english: The dishes Mom cooked, and no corn.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 一半的菜和一半的玉米
choices.simplified: 一半的菜和一半的玉米
choices.pinyin: Yíbàn de cài hé yíbàn de yùmǐ.
choices.english: Half the dishes and half the corn.

questions.why: 菜不帶就算了 drops the dishes (no room in the dorm fridge), 至少帶一半 sets the least corn she will accept, and his 那我拿一半 takes exactly that. The whole bag is more than he agreed to, and no dishes go with him at all.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我放在桌上的那袋麵包呢？你看到了嗎？
lines.simplified: 我放在桌上的那袋面包呢？你看到了吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ fàng zài zhuō shàng de nà dài miànbāo ne? Nǐ kàndào le ma?
lines.english: Where's the bag of bread I left on the table? Have you seen it?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那個舊舊的袋子嗎？我拿下樓丟了。
lines.simplified: 那个旧旧的袋子吗？我拿下楼丢了。
lines.pinyin: Nàge jiùjiù de dàizi ma? Wǒ ná xià lóu diū le.
lines.english: That old-looking bag? I took it downstairs and threw it out.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 什麼？那是我明天的早餐，今天晚上才買的！
lines.simplified: 什么？那是我明天的早餐，今天晚上才买的！
lines.pinyin: Shénme? Nà shì wǒ míngtiān de zǎocān, jīntiān wǎnshàng cái mǎi de!
lines.english: What? That was my breakfast for tomorrow. I only bought it this evening!

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對不起，袋子破了，我以為是上個星期吃剩的，就把它當作垃圾丟了。我現在下去找找看。
lines.simplified: 对不起，袋子破了，我以为是上个星期吃剩的，就把它当作垃圾丢了。我现在下去找找看。
lines.pinyin: Duìbùqǐ, dàizi pò le, wǒ yǐwéi shì shàng ge xīngqí chī shèng de, jiù bǎ tā dāngzuò lèsè diū le. Wǒ xiànzài xiàqù zhǎo zhao kàn.
lines.english: Sorry. The bag was torn; I thought it was last week's leftovers, so I threw it out as rubbish. I'll go down and look for it now.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 算了，垃圾車剛剛已經來過了。那明天早上你請我吃早餐吧。
lines.simplified: 算了，垃圾车刚刚已经来过了。那明天早上你请我吃早餐吧。
lines.pinyin: Suàn le, lèsè chē gānggāng yǐjīng lái guo le. Nà míngtiān zǎoshàng nǐ qǐng wǒ chī zǎocān ba.
lines.english: Forget it, the garbage truck has already been. You can buy me breakfast tomorrow morning, then.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 從對話可以知道什麼？
prompt.simplified: 从对话可以知道什么？
prompt.pinyin: Cóng duìhuà kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?
prompt.english: What can we learn from the conversation?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 女的以為男的把麵包吃了
choices.simplified: 女的以为男的把面包吃了
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de yǐwéi nán de bǎ miànbāo chī le.
choices.english: The woman thought the man had eaten the bread.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 男的知道那是女的明天的早餐
choices.simplified: 男的知道那是女的明天的早餐
choices.pinyin: Nán de zhīdào nà shì nǚ de míngtiān de zǎocān.
choices.english: The man knew it was her breakfast for tomorrow.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 男的以為今天買的麵包是舊的
choices.simplified: 男的以为今天买的面包是旧的
choices.pinyin: Nán de yǐwéi jīntiān mǎi de miànbāo shì jiù de.
choices.english: The man thought bread bought today was old.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 那袋麵包是女的上星期買的
choices.simplified: 那袋面包是女的上星期买的
choices.pinyin: Nà dài miànbāo shì nǚ de shàng xīngqí mǎi de.
choices.english: She bought that bread last week.

questions.why: He thought it was last week's leftovers and so 把它當作垃圾丟了, but 今天晚上才買的 shows he was wrong: he took new bread for old. Last week is only his mistaken idea, she asks where it is rather than accusing him, and he learns it was her breakfast only after throwing it out.

focus.en: treat something as…; combining two turns

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳每個星期天都去樓下那位老太太家吃飯，妳們是家人嗎？
lines.simplified: 你每个星期天都去楼下那位老太太家吃饭，你们是家人吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ měi ge xīngqítiān dōu qù lóuxià nà wèi lǎo tàitai jiā chīfàn, nǐmen shì jiārén ma?
lines.english: You go to the old lady downstairs for dinner every Sunday. Are you family?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不是。我剛搬來的時候，她知道我一個人從國外來，就常叫我去她家吃飯。
lines.simplified: 不是。我刚搬来的时候，她知道我一个人从国外来，就常叫我去她家吃饭。
lines.pinyin: Bú shì. Wǒ gāng bān lái de shíhòu, tā zhīdào wǒ yí ge rén cóng guówài lái, jiù cháng jiào wǒ qù tā jiā chīfàn.
lines.english: No. When I first moved in, she knew I'd come from abroad on my own, so she often asked me over for meals.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 她對妳真好。
lines.simplified: 她对你真好。
lines.pinyin: Tā duì nǐ zhēn hǎo.
lines.english: She's really good to you.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對啊，她早就把我當作自己的孩子了。每次都煮一大堆菜，我說吃不下了，她還要我多吃一點。
lines.simplified: 对啊，她早就把我当作自己的孩子了。每次都煮一大堆菜，我说吃不下了，她还要我多吃一点。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, tā zǎo jiù bǎ wǒ dāngzuò zìjǐ de háizi le. Měi cì dōu zhǔ yí dà duī cài, wǒ shuō chī bú xià le, tā hái yào wǒ duō chī yìdiǎn.
lines.english: Yes. She treated me like her own child long ago. She always cooks loads, and when I say I can't eat any more, she still wants me to have a bit more.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那妳每次都只是去吃飯嗎？
lines.simplified: 那你每次都只是去吃饭吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ měi cì dōu zhǐshì qù chīfàn ma?
lines.english: So do you just go and eat every time?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我會帶一些水果，吃完也幫她洗碗。
lines.simplified: 我会带一些水果，吃完也帮她洗碗。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ huì dài yìxiē shuǐguǒ, chī wán yě bāng tā xǐ wǎn.
lines.english: I take some fruit, and after the meal I help her wash the dishes.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 從對話可以知道什麼？
prompt.simplified: 从对话可以知道什么？
prompt.pinyin: Cóng duìhuà kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?
prompt.english: What can we learn from the conversation?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她剛搬來就常請老太太吃飯
choices.simplified: 她刚搬来就常请老太太吃饭
choices.pinyin: Tā gāng bān lái jiù cháng qǐng lǎo tàitai chīfàn.
choices.english: She often had the old lady over for meals after moving in.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她把老太太當作自己的媽媽
choices.simplified: 她把老太太当作自己的妈妈
choices.pinyin: Tā bǎ lǎo tàitai dāngzuò zìjǐ de māma.
choices.english: She treats the old lady like her own mother.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她每個星期都去幫老太太煮飯
choices.simplified: 她每个星期都去帮老太太煮饭
choices.pinyin: Tā měi ge xīngqí dōu qù bāng lǎo tàitai zhǔ fàn.
choices.english: Every week she goes to help the old lady cook.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 老太太對她像對女兒一樣
choices.simplified: 老太太对她像对女儿一样
choices.pinyin: Lǎo tàitai duì tā xiàng duì nǚ'ér yíyàng.
choices.english: The old lady treats her like a daughter.

questions.why: 把我當作自己的孩子 means the old lady treats her like a daughter, not the other way round: the woman never says she sees the lady as her mother, and her 不是 shows they are not family. It is the lady who invites her, and she helps by bringing fruit and washing up, not by cooking.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽說妳們昨天去爬山，下午下了大雨？
lines.simplified: 听说你们昨天去爬山，下午下了大雨？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐmen zuótiān qù pá shān, xiàwǔ xià le dà yǔ?
lines.english: I hear you went hiking yesterday and it poured in the afternoon?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對啊，雨來得很突然，山路又溼又滑。
lines.simplified: 对啊，雨来得很突然，山路又湿又滑。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, yǔ lái de hěn túrán, shānlù yòu shī yòu huá.
lines.english: Yes, the rain came suddenly, and the mountain path was wet and slippery.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那妳們怎麼下山的？
lines.simplified: 那你们怎么下山的？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐmen zěnme xià shān de?
lines.english: So how did you get down?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 幸虧有一位伯伯開車經過，讓我們坐他的車下山，要不然我們還得走兩個小時。
lines.simplified: 幸亏有一位伯伯开车经过，让我们坐他的车下山，要不然我们还得走两个小时。
lines.pinyin: Xìngkuī yǒu yí wèi bóbo kāichē jīngguò, ràng wǒmen zuò tā de chē xià shān, yàobùrán wǒmen hái děi zǒu liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
lines.english: Luckily an older man drove past and let us ride down in his car; otherwise we'd have had to walk two more hours.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 下次出門以前，先看一下氣象預報吧。
lines.simplified: 下次出门以前，先看一下气象预报吧。
lines.pinyin: Xià cì chūmén yǐqián, xiān kàn yíxià qìxiàng yùbào ba.
lines.english: Next time, check the weather forecast before you go.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我看了啊！預報說是晴天，誰知道會變得這麼快。
lines.simplified: 我看了啊！预报说是晴天，谁知道会变得这么快。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ kàn le a! Yùbào shuō shì qíngtiān, shéi zhīdào huì biàn de zhème kuài.
lines.english: I did! The forecast said sunny. Who knew it would change so fast?

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼說自己運氣好？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么说自己运气好？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme shuō zìjǐ yùnqì hǎo?
prompt.english: Why does the woman count herself lucky?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 出門前她看了氣象預報
choices.simplified: 出门前她看了气象预报
choices.pinyin: Chūmén qián tā kàn le qìxiàng yùbào.
choices.english: She had checked the forecast before going.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她們只走了兩個小時
choices.simplified: 她们只走了两个小时
choices.pinyin: Tāmen zhǐ zǒu le liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
choices.english: They only had to walk two hours.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她們下山以後才開始下大雨
choices.simplified: 她们下山以后才开始下大雨
choices.pinyin: Tāmen xià shān yǐhòu cái kāishǐ xià dà yǔ.
choices.english: The heavy rain started only after they got down.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 有人讓她們不用走路下山
choices.simplified: 有人让她们不用走路下山
choices.pinyin: Yǒu rén ràng tāmen bú yòng zǒulù xià shān.
choices.english: Someone saved them the walk down.

questions.why: 幸虧 marks the lucky part, the man's car; 要不然 tells what they escaped: two more hours on foot. The two hours never happened, the forecast was wrong, and the rain caught them on the mountain.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳上個週末去看的那間房子怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 你上个周末去看的那间房子怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shàng ge zhōumò qù kàn de nà jiān fángzi zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: How was the place you went to see last weekend?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 房租倒是不貴，可是房間小得簡直放不下一張床。
lines.simplified: 房租倒是不贵，可是房间小得简直放不下一张床。
lines.pinyin: Fángzū dàoshì bú guì, kěshì fángjiān xiǎo de jiǎnzhí fàng bú xià yì zhāng chuáng.
lines.english: The rent isn't expensive, actually, but the room is so small you could hardly fit a bed in it.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那離學校近嗎？
lines.simplified: 那离学校近吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà lí xuéxiào jìn ma?
lines.english: Is it close to school, then?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 坐公車要四十分鐘，而且樓下就是夜市，晚上很吵。
lines.simplified: 坐公车要四十分钟，而且楼下就是夜市，晚上很吵。
lines.pinyin: Zuò gōngchē yào sìshí fēnzhōng, érqiě lóuxià jiù shì yèshì, wǎnshàng hěn chǎo.
lines.english: Forty minutes by bus, and there's a night market right downstairs, so it's noisy at night.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽起來不太理想。
lines.simplified: 听起来不太理想。
lines.pinyin: Tīng qǐlái bú tài lǐxiǎng.
lines.english: Doesn't sound ideal.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 總之，那間我是不會租的。這個週末我再去看別的。
lines.simplified: 总之，那间我是不会租的。这个周末我再去看别的。
lines.pinyin: Zǒngzhī, nà jiān wǒ shì bú huì zū de. Zhège zhōumò wǒ zài qù kàn bié de.
lines.english: In short, I'm not renting that one. I'll go and see others this weekend.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的對那間房子有什麼看法？
prompt.simplified: 女的对那间房子有什么看法？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de duì nà jiān fángzi yǒu shénme kànfǎ?
prompt.english: What does the woman think of that place?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 價錢可以，但是不適合住
choices.simplified: 价钱可以，但是不适合住
choices.pinyin: Jiàqián kěyǐ, dànshì bú shìhé zhù.
choices.english: The price is fine, but it isn't right to live in.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 房間很小，可是很安靜
choices.simplified: 房间很小，可是很安静
choices.pinyin: Fángjiān hěn xiǎo, kěshì hěn ānjìng.
choices.english: Small, but quiet.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 只是太遠，要不然就租了
choices.simplified: 只是太远，要不然就租了
choices.pinyin: Zhǐshì tài yuǎn, yàobùrán jiù zū le.
choices.english: Only too far, or she'd take it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 房租太貴，房間也太小
choices.simplified: 房租太贵，房间也太小
choices.pinyin: Fángzū tài guì, fángjiān yě tài xiǎo.
choices.english: Too expensive, and too small.

questions.why: 倒是不貴 grants the rent, then 簡直放不下一張床, the long bus ride and the noisy night market add up to 總之…不會租. It is noisy, not quiet; distance is only one of three problems; and the rent is the one good point.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 學校餐廳最近改了，現在不再一人一份，要自己拿菜。
lines.simplified: 学校餐厅最近改了，现在不再一人一份，要自己拿菜。
lines.pinyin: Xuéxiào cāntīng zuìjìn gǎi le, xiànzài bú zài yì rén yí fèn, yào zìjǐ ná cài.
lines.english: The school cafeteria has changed: no more set portions, you serve yourself now.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你沒看到門口的海報嗎？上面寫著：由於很多同學吃不完，飯菜白白丟掉，因此改成想吃多少就拿多少。
lines.simplified: 你没看到门口的海报吗？上面写着：由于很多同学吃不完，饭菜白白丢掉，因此改成想吃多少就拿多少。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ méi kàndào ménkǒu de hǎibào ma? Shàngmiàn xiězhe: yóuyú hěn duō tóngxué chī bù wán, fàncài báibái diū diào, yīncǐ gǎi chéng xiǎng chī duōshǎo jiù ná duōshǎo.
lines.english: Didn't you see the poster at the door? It says: because many students couldn't finish and food was thrown away for nothing, you now take as much as you want.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這樣不會有人拿太多嗎？
lines.simplified: 这样不会有人拿太多吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng bú huì yǒu rén ná tài duō ma?
lines.english: Won't some people take too much?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 吃完要把盤子拿回去，剩太多的人得多付十塊錢。
lines.simplified: 吃完要把盘子拿回去，剩太多的人得多付十块钱。
lines.pinyin: Chī wán yào bǎ pánzi ná huíqù, shèng tài duō de rén děi duō fù shí kuài qián.
lines.english: You take your plate back when you've eaten, and anyone who leaves too much pays ten dollars extra.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽說這個月丟掉的飯菜少了一半以上。
lines.simplified: 听说这个月丢掉的饭菜少了一半以上。
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhège yuè diū diào de fàncài shǎo le yíbàn yǐshàng.
lines.english: I hear food thrown out this month is down by more than half.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對啊，餐廳省下了不少錢，於是經理決定每天多送大家一份水果。
lines.simplified: 对啊，餐厅省下了不少钱，于是经理决定每天多送大家一份水果。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, cāntīng shěng xià le bù shǎo qián, yúshì jīnglǐ juédìng měi tiān duō sòng dàjiā yí fèn shuǐguǒ.
lines.english: Yes, the cafeteria saved quite a lot, so the manager decided to give everyone a free portion of fruit each day.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 難怪今天多了一個蘋果！不過對我來說，最好的是不用再剩下了。我吃得少，以前一份飯菜總是吃不完。
lines.simplified: 难怪今天多了一个苹果！不过对我来说，最好的是不用再剩下了。我吃得少，以前一份饭菜总是吃不完。
lines.pinyin: Nánguài jīntiān duō le yí ge píngguǒ! Búguò duì wǒ lái shuō, zuì hǎo de shì bú yòng zài shèngxià le. Wǒ chī de shǎo, yǐqián yí fèn fàncài zǒngshì chī bù wán.
lines.english: No wonder there was an extra apple today! But for me the best part is not leaving food any more. I don't eat much, and I could never finish a set portion.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 一個同學拿了很多菜，最後剩下一大半，會怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 一个同学拿了很多菜，最后剩下一大半，会怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Yí ge tóngxué ná le hěn duō cài, zuìhòu shèngxià yí dà bàn, huì zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: A student takes a lot and leaves more than half. What happens?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 下次來吃飯得多付十塊錢
choices.simplified: 下次来吃饭得多付十块钱
choices.pinyin: Xià cì lái chīfàn děi duō fù shí kuài qián.
choices.english: He pays ten dollars more the next time he eats there.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 把盤子拿回去的時候得多付錢
choices.simplified: 把盘子拿回去的时候得多付钱
choices.pinyin: Bǎ pánzi ná huíqù de shíhòu děi duō fù qián.
choices.english: He pays extra when he takes his plate back.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 下次只能拿一人一份
choices.simplified: 下次只能拿一人一份
choices.pinyin: Xià cì zhǐ néng ná yì rén yí fèn.
choices.english: Next time he may take only a set portion.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 得把剩下的吃完才能走
choices.simplified: 得把剩下的吃完才能走
choices.pinyin: Děi bǎ shèngxià de chī wán cái néng zǒu.
choices.english: He must finish it before he can leave.

questions.why: Two lines meet: plates go back after the meal (吃完要把盤子拿回去), and 剩太多的人得多付十塊錢. The extra ten is paid on the spot when the plate goes back, not next time; set portions are the old system; and nobody is made to finish their food.

focus.en: applying a rule to a new case

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 餐廳為什麼能每天多送一份水果？
prompt.simplified: 餐厅为什么能每天多送一份水果？
prompt.pinyin: Cāntīng wèishénme néng měi tiān duō sòng yí fèn shuǐguǒ?
prompt.english: Why can the cafeteria give out extra fruit every day?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 剩菜的同學多付了不少錢
choices.simplified: 剩菜的同学多付了不少钱
choices.pinyin: Shèng cài de tóngxué duō fù le bù shǎo qián.
choices.english: Students who left food paid a lot extra.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 自己拿菜，少請了幾個人
choices.simplified: 自己拿菜，少请了几个人
choices.pinyin: Zìjǐ ná cài, shǎo qǐng le jǐ ge rén.
choices.english: With self-service, it hired fewer staff.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 經理想讓更多同學來餐廳吃飯
choices.simplified: 经理想让更多同学来餐厅吃饭
choices.pinyin: Jīnglǐ xiǎng ràng gèng duō tóngxué lái cāntīng chīfàn.
choices.english: The manager wants more students to eat there.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 丟掉的飯菜比以前少了很多
choices.simplified: 丢掉的饭菜比以前少了很多
choices.pinyin: Diū diào de fàncài bǐ yǐqián shǎo le hěn duō.
choices.english: Much less food is thrown away than before.

questions.why: Two turns link: thrown-out food fell by more than half, so 餐廳省下了不少錢，於是 the manager added fruit. The ten-dollar charge is never said to pay for anything, self-service is not said to cut staff, and drawing more students in is never mentioned.

focus.en: so (an action taken because of it); combining two turns

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得新做法最大的好處是什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得新做法最大的好处是什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde xīn zuòfǎ zuì dà de hǎochù shì shénme?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 自己的飯菜不會再剩下
choices.simplified: 自己的饭菜不会再剩下
choices.pinyin: Zìjǐ de fàncài bú huì zài shèngxià.
choices.english: He no longer leaves food on his plate.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 每天可以多吃一個蘋果
choices.simplified: 每天可以多吃一个苹果
choices.pinyin: Měi tiān kěyǐ duō chī yí ge píngguǒ.
choices.english: He gets an extra apple every day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 餐廳省下的錢比以前多
choices.simplified: 餐厅省下的钱比以前多
choices.pinyin: Cāntīng shěng xià de qián bǐ yǐqián duō.
choices.english: The cafeteria saves more money than before.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 拿太多的人會多付錢
choices.simplified: 拿太多的人会多付钱
choices.pinyin: Ná tài duō de rén huì duō fù qián.
choices.english: People who take too much pay more.

questions.why: His 不過 sets the free apple aside: 最好的是不用再剩下了, since a set portion was always too much for him. The saving is the cafeteria's gain, and the extra charge is a rule he never says he likes.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳們店裡的麵包最近怎麼都賣不完？
lines.simplified: 你们店里的面包最近怎么都卖不完？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen diàn lǐ de miànbāo zuìjìn zěnme dōu mài bù wán?
lines.english: Why isn't your shop selling all its bread lately?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對面新開了一家麵包店，我們的客人就少了很多，每天都剩下二、三十個。
lines.simplified: 对面新开了一家面包店，我们的客人就少了很多，每天都剩下二、三十个。
lines.pinyin: Duìmiàn xīn kāi le yì jiā miànbāo diàn, wǒmen de kèrén jiù shǎo le hěn duō, měi tiān dōu shèngxià èr, sānshí ge.
lines.english: A new bakery opened across the street, so we've lost a lot of customers, and twenty or thirty loaves are left every day.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那剩下的怎麼辦？
lines.simplified: 那剩下的怎么办？
lines.pinyin: Nà shèngxià de zěnme bàn?
lines.english: What happens to the leftovers?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 老闆本來都叫我們丟掉。我覺得太可惜，就建議他晚上八點以後打五折。
lines.simplified: 老板本来都叫我们丢掉。我觉得太可惜，就建议他晚上八点以后打五折。
lines.pinyin: Lǎobǎn běnlái dōu jiào wǒmen diū diào. Wǒ juéde tài kěxí, jiù jiànyì tā wǎnshàng bā diǎn yǐhòu dǎ wǔ zhé.
lines.english: The boss used to tell us to throw it out. I thought that was a waste, so I suggested half price after 8 p.m.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他答應了嗎？
lines.simplified: 他答应了吗？
lines.pinyin: Tā dāyìng le ma?
lines.english: Did he agree?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他怕客人以後都等到八點才來買，不肯。所以我又建議，把麵包送到附近的食物銀行。
lines.simplified: 他怕客人以后都等到八点才来买，不肯。所以我又建议，把面包送到附近的食物银行。
lines.pinyin: Tā pà kèrén yǐhòu dōu děng dào bā diǎn cái lái mǎi, bù kěn. Suǒyǐ wǒ yòu jiànyì, bǎ miànbāo sòng dào fùjìn de shíwù yínháng.
lines.english: He was afraid customers would all wait until eight to buy, so he refused. So I suggested taking the bread to the food bank nearby.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這次他答應了吧？
lines.simplified: 这次他答应了吧？
lines.pinyin: Zhè cì tā dāyìng le ba?
lines.english: He agreed this time, surely?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他說至少比丟掉好，就答應了。現在我每天下班都順便送過去。
lines.simplified: 他说至少比丢掉好，就答应了。现在我每天下班都顺便送过去。
lines.pinyin: Tā shuō zhìshǎo bǐ diū diào hǎo, jiù dāyìng le. Xiànzài wǒ měi tiān xiàbān dōu shùnbiàn sòng guòqù.
lines.english: He said at least it beats throwing it away, and agreed. Now I drop it off every day on my way home from work.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這家麵包店為什麼常常剩下很多麵包？
prompt.simplified: 这家面包店为什么常常剩下很多面包？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè jiā miànbāo diàn wèishénme chángcháng shèngxià hěn duō miànbāo?
prompt.english: Why does this bakery often have a lot of bread left?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 老闆不肯晚上打折
choices.simplified: 老板不肯晚上打折
choices.pinyin: Lǎobǎn bù kěn wǎnshàng dǎzhé.
choices.english: The boss won't discount in the evening.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 客人都等到晚上才買
choices.simplified: 客人都等到晚上才买
choices.pinyin: Kèrén dōu děng dào wǎnshàng cái mǎi.
choices.english: Customers all wait until evening to buy.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 附近多了一家麵包店
choices.simplified: 附近多了一家面包店
choices.pinyin: Fùjìn duō le yì jiā miànbāo diàn.
choices.english: There is now another bakery nearby.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 麵包每天都做得比以前多
choices.simplified: 面包每天都做得比以前多
choices.pinyin: Miànbāo měi tiān dōu zuò de bǐ yǐqián duō.
choices.english: They bake more bread every day than before.

questions.why: 對面新開了一家麵包店，我們的客人就少了: the competition is the cause. Waiting until eight is only what the boss fears might happen, refusing the discount came after the leftovers, and nobody says they bake more than before.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 老闆為什麼沒有答應女的第一個建議？
prompt.simplified: 老板为什么没有答应女的第一个建议？
prompt.pinyin: Lǎobǎn wèishénme méiyǒu dāyìng nǚ de dì yī ge jiànyì?
prompt.english: Why didn't the boss agree to the woman's first suggestion?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 老闆怕客人改到晚上才買
choices.simplified: 老板怕客人改到晚上才买
choices.pinyin: Lǎobǎn pà kèrén gǎi dào wǎnshàng cái mǎi.
choices.english: The boss feared customers would switch to buying at night.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 老闆怕對面的店也跟著打折
choices.simplified: 老板怕对面的店也跟着打折
choices.pinyin: Lǎobǎn pà duìmiàn de diàn yě gēnzhe dǎ zhé.
choices.english: The boss feared the shop across the street would cut prices too.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 老闆覺得打五折賣得太便宜了
choices.simplified: 老板觉得打五折卖得太便宜了
choices.pinyin: Lǎobǎn juéde dǎ wǔ zhé mài de tài piányí le.
choices.english: The boss thought half price was too cheap.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 客人都跑到對面去買了
choices.simplified: 客人都跑到对面去买了
choices.pinyin: Kèrén dōu pǎo dào duìmiàn qù mǎi le.
choices.english: The customers all went across the street.

questions.why: She suggested 打五折, but 他怕客人以後都等到八點才來買，不肯: the boss feared customers would hold off for the discount. He never says the price is too low or mentions what the other shop would do; the shop across the street is only why bread was left in the first place.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 老闆對把麵包送去食物銀行有什麼看法？
prompt.simplified: 老板对把面包送去食物银行有什么看法？
prompt.pinyin: Lǎobǎn duì bǎ miànbāo sòng qù shíwù yínháng yǒu shénme kànfǎ?
prompt.english: What does the boss think of taking the bread to the food bank?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 比丟掉好，還能讓客人變多
choices.simplified: 比丢掉好，还能让客人变多
choices.pinyin: Bǐ diū diào hǎo, hái néng ràng kèrén biàn duō.
choices.english: Better than binning it, and it brings in customers.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 比丟掉好，可是送過去太麻煩
choices.simplified: 比丢掉好，可是送过去太麻烦
choices.pinyin: Bǐ diū diào hǎo, kěshì sòng guòqù tài máfan.
choices.english: Better than binning it, but delivering it is a hassle.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 跟打折一樣，都比丟掉好
choices.simplified: 跟打折一样，都比丢掉好
choices.pinyin: Gēn dǎzhé yíyàng, dōu bǐ diū diào hǎo.
choices.english: Like the discount, it beats binning it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 沒有特別好，只是比丟掉好一點
choices.simplified: 没有特别好，只是比丢掉好一点
choices.pinyin: Méiyǒu tèbié hǎo, zhǐshì bǐ diū diào hǎo yìdiǎn.
choices.english: Nothing special, just better than throwing it out.

questions.why: 至少比丟掉好 sets a low bar: he agrees only because it beats the bin, not because he thinks it is good. Nobody says it brings customers, he never complains about the delivery (she drops it off on her way home), and he refused the discount, so he does not rank it with giving away.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段廣播，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段广播，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn guǎngbò, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a broadcast, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽眾朋友晚安，接下來關心最近蔬菜的價格。
lines.simplified: 听众朋友晚安，接下来关心最近蔬菜的价格。
lines.pinyin: Tīngzhòng péngyǒu wǎn'ān, jiēxiàlái guānxīn zuìjìn shūcài de jiàgé.
lines.english: Good evening, listeners. Next, a look at vegetable prices.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 上個星期的強烈颱風，使得南部很多種菜的田都淹水了，這幾天青菜比平常貴了很多。
lines.simplified: 上个星期的强烈台风，使得南部很多种菜的田都淹水了，这几天青菜比平常贵了很多。
lines.pinyin: Shàng ge xīngqí de qiángliè táifēng, shǐde nánbù hěn duō zhòng cài de tián dōu yānshuǐ le, zhè jǐ tiān qīngcài bǐ píngcháng guì le hěn duō.
lines.english: Last week's strong typhoon flooded many fields in the south, and greens now cost much more than usual.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 農業研究人員表示，由於中部和東部的田沒有受到影響，青菜下個星期就會慢慢變便宜。
lines.simplified: 农业研究人员表示，由于中部和东部的田没有受到影响，青菜下个星期就会慢慢变便宜。
lines.pinyin: Nóngyè yánjiù rényuán biǎoshì, yóuyú zhōngbù hé dōngbù de tián méiyǒu shòudào yǐngxiǎng, qīngcài xià ge xīngqí jiù huì mànmàn biàn piányí.
lines.english: Agricultural researchers say that because fields in the centre and east were not affected, greens will start getting cheaper next week.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不過，南部的田要重新種菜，至少得等一個月。
lines.simplified: 不过，南部的田要重新种菜，至少得等一个月。
lines.pinyin: Búguò, nánbù de tián yào chóngxīn zhòng cài, zhìshǎo děi děng yí ge yuè.
lines.english: But the southern fields will have to wait at least a month before they can be replanted.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 在這段期間，大家可以少買一點青菜，多買玉米這類放得比較久的蔬菜。
lines.simplified: 在这段期间，大家可以少买一点青菜，多买玉米这类放得比较久的蔬菜。
lines.pinyin: Zài zhè duàn qíjiān, dàjiā kěyǐ shǎo mǎi yìdiǎn qīngcài, duō mǎi yùmǐ zhè lèi fàng de bǐjiào jiǔ de shūcài.
lines.english: In the meantime, buy fewer leafy greens and more vegetables that keep longer, such as corn.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 肉和魚的價格這次沒有變，大家不用擔心。
lines.simplified: 肉和鱼的价格这次没有变，大家不用担心。
lines.pinyin: Ròu hé yú de jiàgé zhè cì méiyǒu biàn, dàjiā bú yòng dānxīn.
lines.english: Meat and fish prices haven't changed this time, so there's no need to worry.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 買回家的青菜，最好三天以內吃完，以免放壞了，白白丟掉。
lines.simplified: 买回家的青菜，最好三天以内吃完，以免放坏了，白白丢掉。
lines.pinyin: Mǎi huí jiā de qīngcài, zuì hǎo sān tiān yǐnèi chī wán, yǐmiǎn fàng huài le, báibái diū diào.
lines.english: Eat the greens you buy within three days, so they don't go bad and get thrown away for nothing.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 研究人員為什麼認為青菜下星期會變便宜？
prompt.simplified: 研究人员为什么认为青菜下星期会变便宜？
prompt.pinyin: Yánjiù rényuán wèishénme rènwéi qīngcài xià xīngqí huì biàn piányí?
prompt.english: Why do the researchers think greens will get cheaper next week?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 肉和魚的價格都沒有變
choices.simplified: 肉和鱼的价格都没有变
choices.pinyin: Ròu hé yú de jiàgé dōu méiyǒu biàn.
choices.english: Meat and fish prices have not changed.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 別的地區的菜還是種得好好的

choices.pinyin: Bié de dìqū de cài háishì zhòng de hǎohǎo de.
choices.english: Crops in other regions are still growing fine.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 大家改買玉米，青菜買得少
choices.simplified: 大家改买玉米，青菜买得少
choices.pinyin: Dàjiā gǎi mǎi yùmǐ, qīngcài mǎi de shǎo.
choices.english: People buy corn instead, so fewer greens are bought.

choices.traditional: 研究人員會幫南部重新種菜

choices.pinyin: Yánjiù rényuán huì bāng nánbù chóngxīn zhòng cài.
choices.english: Researchers will help the south replant.

questions.why: 由於中部和東部的田沒有受到影響 is the researchers' reason: other regions can still supply greens. Unchanged meat and fish prices say nothing about greens, buying corn is the broadcaster's tip rather than the researchers' reason, and nobody says researchers will do the replanting.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這次颱風造成了什麼結果？
prompt.simplified: 这次台风造成了什么结果？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng zàochéng le shénme jiéguǒ?
prompt.english: What did this typhoon lead to?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 中部和東部的田也淹水了
choices.simplified: 中部和东部的田也淹水了
choices.pinyin: Zhōngbù hé dōngbù de tián yě yānshuǐ le.
choices.english: Fields in the centre and east flooded too.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 南部的田下星期就能再種
choices.simplified: 南部的田下星期就能再种
choices.pinyin: Nánbù de tián xià xīngqí jiù néng zài zhòng.
choices.english: Southern fields can be replanted next week.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 南部至少一個月不能種菜
choices.simplified: 南部至少一个月不能种菜
choices.pinyin: Nánbù zhìshǎo yí ge yuè bù néng zhòng cài.
choices.english: The south can't plant for at least a month.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 青菜至少一個月都會比平常貴
choices.simplified: 青菜至少一个月都会比平常贵
choices.pinyin: Qīngcài zhìshǎo yí ge yuè dōu huì bǐ píngcháng guì.
choices.english: Greens will cost more than usual for at least a month.

questions.why: Two lines combine: the typhoon 使得南部很多種菜的田都淹水了, and those fields must wait 至少一個月 to be replanted. The month is the wait for replanting, not for prices, which start falling next week; the centre and east were not hit; and next week is when prices fall, not when the south can plant.

focus.en: to cause; at least; combining two lines

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這段廣播主要是要告訴聽眾什麼？
prompt.simplified: 这段广播主要是要告诉听众什么？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè duàn guǎngbò zhǔyào shì yào gàosu tīngzhòng shénme?
prompt.english: What is this broadcast mainly telling listeners?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 菜為什麼變貴，這段時間怎麼買
choices.simplified: 菜为什么变贵，这段时间怎么买
choices.pinyin: Cài wèishénme biàn guì, zhè duàn shíjiān zěnme mǎi.
choices.english: Why greens cost more, and how to shop meanwhile.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 颱風以後南部要怎麼重新種菜
choices.simplified: 台风以后南部要怎么重新种菜
choices.pinyin: Táifēng yǐhòu nánbù yào zěnme chóngxīn zhòng cài.
choices.english: How the south will replant after the typhoon.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 菜為什麼變貴，該多買肉和魚
choices.simplified: 菜为什么变贵，该多买肉和鱼
choices.pinyin: Cài wèishénme biàn guì, gāi duō mǎi ròu hé yú.
choices.english: Why greens cost more, and that people should buy more meat and fish.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 什麼菜變貴了，什麼菜變便宜了
choices.simplified: 什么菜变贵了，什么菜变便宜了
choices.pinyin: Shénme cài biàn guì le, shénme cài biàn piányí le.
choices.english: Which vegetables have gone up, and which have gone down.

questions.why: The first half explains the price rise and the second half tells listeners what to buy and how soon to eat it. Replanting is one line; the advice is to buy corn and other vegetables that keep, not meat and fish, which only stayed the same price; and nothing has got cheaper.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段留言，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn liúyán, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a voice message, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我是阿姨。你上次說你們社團想去食物銀行幫忙，也想把同學送的東西帶過去，我幫你問了。
lines.simplified: 我是阿姨。你上次说你们社团想去食物银行帮忙，也想把同学送的东西带过去，我帮你问了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shì āyí. Nǐ shàng cì shuō nǐmen shètuán xiǎng qù shíwù yínháng bāngmáng, yě xiǎng bǎ tóngxué sòng de dōngxi dài guòqù, wǒ bāng nǐ wèn le.
lines.english: It's your aunt. You said your club wanted to help at the food bank and bring along things your classmates gave, so I asked for you.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他們說由於最近天氣很熱，食物容易壞，所以現在只收沒打開過的東西，像米、麵條。
lines.simplified: 他们说由于最近天气很热，食物容易坏，所以现在只收没打开过的东西，像米、面条。
lines.pinyin: Tāmen shuō yóuyú zuìjìn tiānqì hěn rè, shíwù róngyì huài, suǒyǐ xiànzài zhǐ shōu méi dǎkāi guo de dōngxi, xiàng mǐ, miàntiáo.
lines.english: They say that because it's been hot lately and food spoils easily, they now accept only unopened things, like rice and noodles.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他們本來每個星期六都需要人幫忙，可是最近星期六去幫忙的人太多了，所以希望你們改成星期三下午去。
lines.simplified: 他们本来每个星期六都需要人帮忙，可是最近星期六去帮忙的人太多了，所以希望你们改成星期三下午去。
lines.pinyin: Tāmen běnlái měi ge xīngqíliù dōu xūyào rén bāngmáng, kěshì zuìjìn xīngqíliù qù bāngmáng de rén tài duō le, suǒyǐ xīwàng nǐmen gǎi chéng xīngqísān xiàwǔ qù.
lines.english: They used to need helpers every Saturday, but lately too many people go on Saturdays, so they'd like you to go on Wednesday afternoon instead.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你們至少要去五個人，因為那天他們要把東西送到三個地方。
lines.simplified: 你们至少要去五个人，因为那天他们要把东西送到三个地方。
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen zhìshǎo yào qù wǔ ge rén, yīnwèi nà tiān tāmen yào bǎ dōngxi sòng dào sān ge dìfāng.
lines.english: You need at least five people, because that day they deliver to three places.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 要是你們決定去，星期五以前打電話給我，我幫你們安排。
lines.simplified: 要是你们决定去，星期五以前打电话给我，我帮你们安排。
lines.pinyin: Yàoshì nǐmen juédìng qù, xīngqíwǔ yǐqián dǎ diànhuà gěi wǒ, wǒ bāng nǐmen ānpái.
lines.english: If you decide to go, call me before Friday and I'll arrange it.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 下面哪一種安排最符合食物銀行的需求？
prompt.simplified: 下面哪一种安排最符合食物银行的需求？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàmiàn nǎ yì zhǒng ānpái zuì fúhé shíwù yínháng de xūqiú?
prompt.english: Which arrangement best meets the food bank's needs?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 星期六下午去六個人
choices.simplified: 星期六下午去六个人
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíliù xiàwǔ qù liù ge rén.
choices.english: Six people on Saturday afternoon.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 星期三下午去六個人
choices.simplified: 星期三下午去六个人
choices.pinyin: Xīngqísān xiàwǔ qù liù ge rén.
choices.english: Six people on Wednesday afternoon.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 星期三下午去三個人
choices.simplified: 星期三下午去三个人
choices.pinyin: Xīngqísān xiàwǔ qù sān ge rén.
choices.english: Three people on Wednesday afternoon.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 星期五下午去五個人
choices.simplified: 星期五下午去五个人
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíwǔ xiàwǔ qù wǔ ge rén.
choices.english: Five people on Friday afternoon.

questions.why: Two lines combine: 改成星期三下午 and 至少要去五個人, so six on Wednesday fits. Saturday is the old day, three is the number of delivery places, and Friday is only the deadline for calling.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 社團有同學想把自己煮的湯帶去，食物銀行會收嗎？
prompt.simplified: 社团有同学想把自己煮的汤带去，食物银行会收吗？

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 會，只要星期三下午送去
choices.simplified: 会，只要星期三下午送去
choices.pinyin: Huì, zhǐyào xīngqísān xiàwǔ sòng qù.
choices.english: Yes, as long as it goes on Wednesday afternoon.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 會，只要星期五以前打電話
choices.simplified: 会，只要星期五以前打电话
choices.pinyin: Huì, zhǐyào xīngqíwǔ yǐqián dǎ diànhuà.
choices.english: Yes, as long as someone calls before Friday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 不會，因為他們只收米和麵條
choices.simplified: 不会，因为他们只收米和面条
choices.pinyin: Bú huì, yīnwèi tāmen zhǐ shōu mǐ hé miàntiáo.
choices.english: No, because they take only rice and noodles.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 不會，天熱時只收沒開過的
choices.simplified: 不会，天热时只收没开过的
choices.pinyin: Bú huì, tiān rè shí zhǐ shōu méi kāi guo de.
choices.english: No: in the heat they take only unopened food.

questions.why: 由於天氣很熱，食物容易壞，所以只收沒打開過的東西: home-made soup is not an unopened packet. Wednesday and the Friday call are about when to help, not what they accept, and rice and noodles are only examples (像), not the whole list.

focus.zh: 由於……，所以……；規定用在新的情況
focus.en: owing to…, so…; applying a rule

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 阿姨打電話來，主要是為了什麼？
prompt.simplified: 阿姨打电话来，主要是为了什么？
prompt.pinyin: Āyí dǎ diànhuà lái, zhǔyào shì wèile shénme?
prompt.english: What is the aunt mainly calling for?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 請他找五個同學星期六去
choices.simplified: 请他找五个同学星期六去
choices.pinyin: Qǐng tā zhǎo wǔ ge tóngxué xīngqíliù qù.
choices.english: To ask him to bring five classmates on Saturday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 請他星期五以前把東西送去
choices.simplified: 请他星期五以前把东西送去
choices.pinyin: Qǐng tā xīngqíwǔ yǐqián bǎ dōngxi sòng qù.
choices.english: To ask him to take the things over before Friday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 告訴他能送什麼、哪天能去
choices.simplified: 告诉他能送什么、哪天能去
choices.pinyin: Gàosù tā néng sòng shénme, nǎ tiān néng qù.
choices.english: To tell him what they can bring and which day they can go.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 告訴他星期六人不夠，請他們去
choices.simplified: 告诉他星期六人不够，请他们去
choices.pinyin: Gàosù tā xīngqíliù rén bú gòu, qǐng tāmen qù.
choices.english: To say Saturdays are short of people and ask them to come.

questions.why: She reports what she found out: only unopened food, Wednesday instead of Saturday, at least five people, and call by Friday. Saturday is the old day, and it has too many helpers, not too few; Friday is the deadline for calling her, not for taking things over.

passage.traditional: 我哥哥是一位廚師，三年前跟朋友一起{1}了一家小餐廳。剛開始生意不太{2}，令他十分煩惱。他不斷改進菜的味道，{3}客人仍然不多，每天都有不少米飯和麵條被丟掉。{4}他決定晚上九點以後，把還沒賣完的食物便宜賣給附近的學生。這個做法很有效，{5}店裡的客人一天比一天多。現在一到晚上，溫暖的燈光下，每張餐桌都坐滿了人。哥哥得意地說，{6}生意多忙，他都不會再把能吃的食物當作垃圾了。
passage.simplified: 我哥哥是一位厨师，三年前跟朋友一起{1}了一家小餐厅。刚开始生意不太{2}，令他十分烦恼。他不断改进菜的味道，{3}客人仍然不多，每天都有不少米饭和面条被丢掉。{4}他决定晚上九点以后，把还没卖完的食物便宜卖给附近的学生。这个做法很有效，{5}店里的客人一天比一天多。现在一到晚上，温暖的灯光下，每张餐桌都坐满了人。哥哥得意地说，{6}生意多忙，他都不会再把能吃的食物当作垃圾了。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ gēge shì yí wèi chúshī, sān nián qián gēn péngyǒu yìqǐ tóuzī le yì jiā xiǎo cāntīng. Gāng kāishǐ shēngyì bú tài wěndìng, lìng tā shífēn fánnǎo. Tā búduàn gǎijìn cài de wèidào, jiéguǒ kèrén réngrán bù duō, měi tiān dōu yǒu bù shǎo mǐfàn hé miàntiáo bèi diū diào. Yúshì tā juédìng wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn yǐhòu, bǎ hái méi mài wán de shíwù piányí mài gěi fùjìn de xuéshēng. Zhège zuòfǎ hěn yǒuxiào, shǐde diàn lǐ de kèrén yì tiān bǐ yì tiān duō. Xiànzài yí dào wǎnshàng, wēnnuǎn de dēngguāng xià, měi zhāng cānzhuō dōu zuò mǎn le rén. Gēge déyì de shuō, búlùn shēngyì duō máng, tā dōu bú huì zài bǎ néng chī de shíwù dāngzuò lèsè le.
passage.english: My older brother is a chef. Three years ago he and a friend invested in a small restaurant. At first business was not very stable, which worried him a great deal. He kept improving the taste of his dishes, yet in the end there were still few customers, and every day a lot of rice and noodles were thrown away. So he decided that after nine in the evening he would sell the unsold food cheaply to students nearby. This worked well, and it made the customers in the restaurant grow day by day. Now, as soon as evening comes, every dining table is full under the warm lights. My brother says proudly that however busy business gets, he will never again treat food that can be eaten as garbage.

Jǐnguǎn mùqián zhèyàng de bīngxiāng hái bù pǔbiàn, wǒ réngrán xiāngxìn, jiānglái měi ge shèqū zhìshǎo dōu huì yǒu yí ge.
passage.english: There is a community fridge at the entrance of our neighbourhood. Everyone can put food they cannot finish in it, for people who need it. At first nobody looked after it; someone put in food that had already gone rotten, and it was not until someone ate it and got a bad stomach that people noticed the problem. So the neighbourhood's management staff came up with a new method: before putting food in, you must ask them to check it on the spot, so that the same thing does not happen again. This method has made everyone feel more at ease, and more and more people come to take food, which proves that doing it this way works. Although fridges like this are not yet common, I still believe that one day every neighbourhood will have at least one.

title.english: Is There Really Not Enough Food?

text.traditional:
目前全球人口不斷增加，可以種田的土地面積卻越來越小，不少人擔心將來食物會不夠。為了解決這個問題，許多國家提供經費，讓科學家在農業領域進行研究。這幾十年來，他們發明了不少新方法，使得同樣大小的田能種出更多的米和玉米。
不過，有一位研究人員從不同的角度來看這個問題。記者訪問他的時候，他表示，「食物不夠」只是理論上的說法，因為全世界每年生產的食物，其實夠所有的人吃。真正的問題是，在工業發達的國家，有三分之一的食物還沒吃就被丟掉了；在一些很窮的地區，卻有很多人連一天兩頓飯都吃不飽。
他的觀點是，丟掉食物的行為在這些國家十分普遍，這跟社會的觀念有密切的關係：東西越容易買到，人們就越不愛惜。因此，只發明新方法仍然無法解決問題，更重要的是改變大家的觀念。他的研究也證明，只要每個人少丟一點，就能讓許多人有飯吃。既然如此，食物問題就不能只留給科學家去解決，這是所有人共同的責任。
text.simplified:

不过，有一位研究人员从不同的角度来看这个问题。记者访问他的时候，他表示，「食物不够」只是理论上的说法，因为全世界每年生产的食物，其实够所有的人吃。真正的问题是，在工业发达的国家，有三分之一的食物还没吃就被丢掉了；在一些很穷的地区，却有很多人连一天两顿饭都吃不饱。
他的观点是，丢掉食物的行为在这些国家十分普遍，这跟社会的观念有密切的关系：东西越容易买到，人们就越不爱惜。因此，只发明新方法仍然无法解决问题，更重要的是改变大家的观念。他的研究也证明，只要每个人少丢一点，就能让许多人有饭吃。既然如此，食物问题就不能只留给科学家去解决，这是所有人共同的责任。
text.pinyin: Mùqián quánqiú rénkǒu búduàn zēngjiā, kěyǐ zhòngtián de tǔdì miànjī què yuè lái yuè xiǎo, bù shǎo rén dānxīn jiānglái shíwù huì bú gòu. Wèile jiějué zhège wèntí, xǔduō guójiā tígōng jīngfèi, ràng kēxuéjiā zài nóngyè lǐngyù jìnxíng yánjiù. Zhè jǐ shí nián lái, tāmen fāmíng le bù shǎo xīn fāngfǎ, shǐde tóngyàng dàxiǎo de tián néng zhòng chū gèng duō de mǐ hé yùmǐ. Búguò, yǒu yí wèi yánjiù rényuán cóng bùtóng de jiǎodù lái kàn zhège wèntí. Jìzhě fǎngwèn tā de shíhòu, tā biǎoshi, "shíwù bú gòu" zhǐ shì lǐlùn shàng de shuōfǎ, yīnwèi quán shìjiè měi nián shēngchǎn de shíwù, qíshí gòu suǒyǒu de rén chī. Zhēnzhèng de wèntí shì, zài gōngyè fādá de guójiā, yǒu sān fēn zhī yī de shíwù hái méi chī jiù bèi diū diào le; zài yìxiē hěn qióng de dìqū, què yǒu hěn duō rén lián yì tiān liǎng dùn fàn dōu chī bù bǎo. Tā de guāndiǎn shì, diū diào shíwù de xíngwéi zài zhèxiē guójiā shífēn pǔbiàn, zhè gēn shèhuì de guānniàn yǒu mìqiè de guānxì: dōngxi yuè róngyì mǎi dào, rénmen jiù yuè bú àixí. Tā de yánjiù yě zhèngmíng, zhǐyào měi ge rén shǎo diū yìdiǎn, jiù néng ràng xǔduō rén yǒu fàn chī. Jìrán rúcǐ, shíwù wèntí jiù bù néng zhǐ liú gěi kēxuéjiā qù jiějué, zhè shì suǒyǒu rén gòngtóng de zérèn.
text.english:
At present the world's population keeps growing while the area of land that can be farmed gets smaller and smaller, and many people worry that one day there will not be enough food. To solve this problem, many countries provide funding for scientists to do research in the field of agriculture. Over the past few decades they have invented many new methods, which let a field of the same size grow more rice and corn.
But one researcher looks at the problem from a different angle. When a reporter interviewed him, he said that "not enough food" is only true in theory, because the food the whole world produces each year is in fact enough for everyone to eat. The real problem is that in industrially developed countries a third of the food is thrown away before it is eaten, while in some very poor regions many people cannot even get two full meals a day.
His view is that throwing food away is very common in these countries, and that this is closely tied to how a society thinks: the easier things are to buy, the less people cherish them. So inventing new methods alone still cannot solve the problem; what matters more is changing how everyone thinks. His research also proves that if each person throws away a little less, many people can have food to eat. Since that is so, the food problem cannot just be left for scientists to solve; it is a responsibility everyone shares.

text.traditional:
林小姐本來在銀行上班。三年前，她回到家鄉，投資開了一家小公司，只賣樣子不好看的蔬菜和水果。
在農業發達的今天，超市裡的蔬菜大小都差不多，樣子也很漂亮。可是很少人知道，田裡大約有三分之一的蔬菜，只因為長得醜，無法進超市，還沒離開田就被當作垃圾丟掉了。林小姐認為，從道德的角度來看，這樣的行為是不對的，因為這些蔬菜的營養和味道一點也不差。
剛開始，公司的生意很不穩定，令她十分煩惱。客人普遍認為，醜的東西品質一定不好。可是她不願意就這樣結束，於是請了一位有名的廚師用這些蔬菜做菜，讓客人當場吃吃看。客人吃了都很驚訝，這證明了好不好吃跟樣子無關。
目前，她的公司跟一百多位種菜的人合作，生意也穩定多了。記者訪問她的時候，問她最得意的是什麼。她說，不是公司賣了多少蔬菜，是越來越多人接受了她的觀點：一切能吃的食物都有價值。她還說，無論如何，她都會堅持到底。

刚开始，公司的生意很不稳定，令她十分烦恼。客人普遍认为，丑的东西品质一定不好。可是她不愿意就这样结束，于是请了一位有名的厨师用这些蔬菜做菜，让客人当场吃吃看。客人吃了都很惊讶，这证明了好不好吃跟样子无关。

Lín xiǎojiě rènwéi, cóng dàodé de jiǎodù lái kàn, zhèyàng de xíngwéi shì bú duì de, yīnwèi zhèxiē shūcài de yíngyǎng hé wèidào yìdiǎn yě bú chà. Gāng kāishǐ, gōngsī de shēngyì hěn bù wěndìng, lìng tā shífēn fánnǎo. Kèrén pǔbiàn rènwéi, chǒu de dōngxi pǐnzhí yídìng bù hǎo. Kěshì tā bú yuànyì jiù zhèyàng jiéshù, yúshì qǐng le yí wèi yǒumíng de chúshī yòng zhèxiē shūcài zuò cài, ràng kèrén dāngchǎng chī chī kàn. Kèrén chī le dōu hěn jīngyà, zhè zhèngmíng le hǎo bù hǎochī gēn yàngzi wúguān. Mùqián, tā de gōngsī gēn yìbǎi duō wèi zhòng cài de rén hézuò, shēngyì yě wěndìng duō le. Jìzhě fǎngwèn tā de shíhòu, wèn tā zuì déyì de shì shénme. Tā shuō, bú shì gōngsī mài le duōshǎo shūcài, shì yuè lái yuè duō rén jiēshòu le tā de guāndiǎn: yíqiè néng chī de shíwù dōu yǒu jiàzhí. Tā hái shuō, wúlùnrúhé, tā dōu huì jiānchí dàodǐ.
text.english:
Ms. Lin used to work in a bank. Three years ago she went back to her hometown and invested in starting a small company that sells nothing but fruit and vegetables that do not look good.
Now that farming is so advanced, the vegetables in a supermarket are all about the same size and look lovely. But few people know that about a third of the vegetables in the fields, just because they are ugly, cannot get into supermarkets and are thrown away as garbage before they even leave the field. Ms. Lin thinks that from a moral point of view this is wrong, because these vegetables are every bit as nutritious and tasty.
At first the company's business was very unstable, which worried her a great deal. Customers generally thought that ugly things must be poor in quality. But she was not willing to let it end like that, so she asked a well-known chef to cook with these vegetables and let customers taste the dishes on the spot. The customers were surprised when they ate them, and this proved that how something tastes has nothing to do with how it looks.
At present her company works with more than a hundred growers, and business is much steadier. When a reporter interviewed her and asked what she was proudest of, she said it was not how many vegetables the company had sold, but that more and more people had accepted her view: all food that can be eaten has value. She also said that whatever happens, she will see it through to the end.
